about_short_description.short_description: BHM Capital is a fintech company that provides financial services.

product.name: Brokerage and Trading Services
product.description: Execution and access to local, regional, and international financial markets for individual, corporate, and institutional investors across multiple asset classes.

product.name: Asset Management
product.description: Investment management services for clients seeking professional portfolio management across financial markets and asset classes.

product.name: Advisory and Research
product.description: Market research, investment analysis, and corporate advisory services that support investment decisions and capital-markets transactions.

product.name: Market Making and Liquidity Provision
product.description: Market-making and liquidity services that provide two-way quotes and support orderly trading in listed securities.

product.name: Prime Brokerage
product.description: Prime brokerage services for professional and institutional clients requiring market access, trading support, and related capital-markets capabilities.

product.name: Fixed Income Services
product.description: Access to and services related to fixed-income instruments, including bonds and other debt-market investments.
